notes.title: Dating Maze Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest – Play Today!
notes.notes: [p][b]Experience the Dating Maze Demo During Steam Next Fest – June 2025![/b][/p][p]We’re excited to share that the demo for our upcoming game, [b]Dating Maze[/b], is now live as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/p][p]Jump in now to get an exclusive first look at what we’ve been building. Discover new mechanics, meet unforgettable characters, and explore a world crafted with care by our passionate team.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback, which will help shape the final version of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Click here to play the demo now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3184700/Dating_Maze/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b], [b]share[/b], and [b]join us on this journey from the very beginning![/b][/p]

notes.title: Public Bounce is on "Steam Visual Novel Fest"!
notes.notes:
🚀 As part of the Steam Visual Novel Fest, we're thrilled to announce an exclusive limited-time offer! From Aug 7 - Aug 14 at 10 am PT, grab our captivating [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437380/Public_Bounce__Public_Secrets/?curator_clanid=42262257]DLC at an incredible 20% discount[/url]. 🎮✨ And remember, the base game is FREE to play!

🌍 But that's not all - we've been listening to our amazing community! In response to your requests, we've added subtitles in both French and Japanese, allowing players around the world to immerse themselves in the Public Bounce universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262257/357a20f3c5edb9e036374b2df77e78a10d356a72.jpg[/img]

If you have any feedback or run into any issues, join our [url=https://discord.gg/RYHC52bywH]Official Discord server![/url] and let us know.

We hope you all can enjoy the "Steam Visual Novel Fest"!
